3.5.5 release (previous 3.5.4) + release notes updated by CI build 4734

[ci skip-release]

[ci maven-central-release] Merge pull request #2020 from mockito/constructor-dispatch

Constructor dispatch

Add validation to MockMethodDispatcher that this class is only ever loaded by the bootstrap class loader.

This is normally assured by Mockito but other testing frameworks that work with instrumentation can interfer with this. This might be difficult to discover for those frameworks as seen with Robolectric. This explicit error should help to discover such discrepencies.
